paite: Luita tui duh a nak hawkhawk sakhi bang in, Pathian aw, ka hinna nangmah duh in anak hawkhawk hi.
heading: Korah Tate La / BU NIHNA / (Sam 42-72) / Saltangmi Thumna;

paite: Ka hinna Pathian duh in, Pathian hing duh in, adangtak ahi; chikchiang in ahia Pathian ma ka tun ding a, amai ka muh ding.
Ka khitui sun leh zan in ka an ahi a, na Pathian koi a om ahia le! hon chi nilouh ua.
Hiai thil ka theigige a, ka hinna ka sung ah ka sungbua a, mipi lak a ka pai in, nopna leh phatna ging toh, mi tampi ankuangluina a Pathian inn zuan a ama uh ka kaih zeldante.
Ka hinna aw, bang achia kun nilouh? Bang achia ka sung a buai? Pathian lamen in; amel a damna ziak in amah ka hon phat ding ahi ngal a, hon panpihpa leh ka Pathian.
Ka Pathian aw, ka hinna ka sung ah akun nilouh; huaiziak in Jordan leh Hermon gam a kipan, Mizar tang a kipan in ka hon theigige ahi.
Na tui luang ging zuazuate ah tui thuk leh tui thuk akisam ua; na tuikihot leh na tui kisep teng in hon vuktumta hi.
Himahleh, TOUPA'N azahngaihna sun in thu ape ding a, ala in zan chiang in hon ompih ding hi, ka hinna Pathian kiang a thumna in.
Pathian ka suangpi kiang ah, "Bangziak a hon mangngilh a bang ding a melma nuaisiahna ziak a lungkham a ka mau vialvial nak!" ka chi ding hi.
Ka guh a namsau om bang mai in hon doute'n hon gense gige ua; Na Pathian koi a om ahia le! Hon chi nilouh ua.
Ka hinna aw, bang achia kun nilouh? Bang achia ka sung a buai? Pathian lamen in; amah ka phat ding a, hon panpihpa leh ka Pathian ahi.
